**Job Title: Sr. Software Engineer – R\&D (5G/Cloud\-Native Networks)**
**Job Description**
 This Sr. level Software Engineer role focuses on research and development for cutting\-edge 5G NR and 4G LTE products and solutions within a product development team. You design, implement, and test cloud\-native network management systems running on modern virtualization platforms such as Kubernetes, Rancher, and ESXi, while developing in languages like Go, C/C\+\+, Java, and SQL. You contribute to innovative hardware and software configurations that support unique customer requirements, including integration with Tier 3 networks, SIM management, charging and billing systems, and emerging AI use cases in large and small data center environments. This position reports to the R\&D Director and plays a key role in advancing next\-generation telecommunications infrastructure.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Collaborate with the R\&D team to design, implement, and functionally test software products for 5G NR and 4G LTE solutions.
* Work closely with R\&D teams on product releases, including defining features, requirements, and test tools.
* Mentor and lead less experienced software engineers, providing technical guidance and support.
* Communicate effectively with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders to ensure project alignment and clarity.
* Proactively maintain and enhance technical skillsets to keep pace with evolving technologies and industry best practices.
* Manage time effectively to meet project schedules and deliverables.
* Demonstrate initiative by identifying opportunities for improvement and driving solutions.
* Interact with project leadership and other team members as needed to meet project milestones and deadlines.
* Design, implement, and test software components and services for target Linux platforms.
* Create and maintain shared libraries used across multiple products and platforms.
* Develop multi\-threaded and multi\-process applications following established development best practices.
* Implement and manage Linux services, including installation, configuration, and ongoing maintenance.
* Develop network programming solutions with robust client/server architectures.
* Build web server applications using HTML and server\-side languages such as PHP, Node.js, or Go.
* Design relational database schemas, create and execute SQL programmatically, and optimize code for long\-term database performance.
* Configure, integrate, and design solutions using virtualization technologies such as ESXi, VMware, and Kubernetes.
* Contribute to the development of management systems for telecommunications networks, integrating with Tier 3 networks and SIM management, charging, billing, and AI\-related functionalities.
* Support the integration of AI use cases into larger network environments, including big and small data centers.
* Participate in studies and efforts to migrate from existing VMware/ESXi deployments to modern platforms.
* Apply good analytical and problem\-solving skills to troubleshoot complex issues with minimal supervision.
* Maintain strong partnership interactions and manage complex relationships associated with R\&D projects.
* Ensure high\-quality deliverables by working under pressure, meeting deadlines, and adhering to development standards.
* Travel domestically and internationally as needed, generally less than 10%, to support project and customer needs.


**Essential Skills**
* Bachelor’s degree (BS) required.
* 10–12\+ years of experience in software development.
* Strong ability to work in a small team environment focused on designing, implementing, and testing products.
* Excellent knowledge of C, C\+\+, Java, and Go for target Linux platforms.
* Experience creating and maintaining shared libraries across multiple products and platforms.
* Extensive experience with multi\-threaded development and adherence to development best practices.
* Strong experience with GitLab and GitLab Runners for source control, builds, and trouble report management.
* Solid experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies.
* Experience with at least one of the following development tools: CLion or Android Studio.
* Excellent experience with Linux platforms, including permission levels and multi\-process concepts.
* Excellent experience installing, managing, and developing Linux services.
* Experience developing in at least one of Go, Angular, or Rust for target Linux platforms.
* Excellent network programming skills with client/server experience.
* Strong knowledge of web server application development using HTML and server\-side languages such as PHP, Node.js, or Go.
* 2–3\+ years of relational database experience, including designing data tables, creating and executing SQL programmatically, and coding for long\-term database performance.
* Good knowledge of virtual machines, containers, and virtual environments.
* Good understanding of client/server architectures.
* Good understanding of IP networks.
* Effective communication skills, both written and oral, with the ability to express ideas and exchange information clearly.
* Fluency in English.
* Ability to work under pressure, meet deadlines, and deliver high\-quality results.
* Ability to solve problems and work with minimal supervision.
* Ability to learn quickly and collaborate effectively in a team environment.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Good breadth of telecommunications technologies.
* Ability to build and manage complex relationships associated with R\&D projects.
* Legally able to work in the U.S.
* Willingness and ability to be granted a security clearance.


**Additional Skills \& Qualifications**
* Experience developing software for telecommunications is a plus, including familiarity with NR, LTE, and GSM wireless technologies and related protocols.
* Modern Android development experience is a plus.
* Device driver development experience is a plus.
* Experience with kernel\-level development is a plus.
* Understanding of peer\-to\-peer encryption is a plus.
* Understanding of information assurance requirements on products is a plus.
* Experience with ESXi and VMware virtualization platforms.
* Experience with Kubernetes and container orchestration.
* Experience with networking configuration, integration, and design.
* Experience with Go development for backend services.
* Experience with backend databases such as MariaDB, open\-source data stores, Redpanda, or KSQL.
* Industry experience in telecommunications is beneficial but not required.
* Interest or experience in cybersecurity and AI, particularly in network\-related use cases.
* Experience working with large and small data centers and integrating AI into network infrastructure.
* Less than 10% domestic travel and up to approximately 5% international travel may be required.


**Work Environment**
 You join a collaborative R\&D team of approximately 10–12 software engineers working on advanced 5G NR and 4G LTE network products and cloud\-native management systems. The environment centers on Linux\-based development using PCs, workstations, and mobile devices, with extensive use of GitLab for software builds and trouble report management. The team follows Agile/Scrum methodologies and works with virtualization and container technologies such as VMware, ESXi, and Kubernetes, as well as tools like Rancher, Ansible, and Helm. Work involves both large and small data center contexts, integrating AI capabilities into broader network infrastructure. Travel requirements are modest, with less than 10% overall travel and occasional international trips, providing exposure to diverse network deployments while maintaining a primarily office\-based, team\-oriented setting.
   

  

**Job Type \& Location**
 This is a Contract to Hire position based out of The Colony, TX.
   

  

**Pay And Benefits**
 The pay range for this position is $70\.00 \- $86\.00/hr.
   

  

 Individual compensation offered for this position within this range will depend on many factors, including qualifications, skills, relevant experience, job knowledge, geographic location, internal equity, and other pertinent job\-related factors.
   

  

 Eligibility requirements apply to some benefits and may depend on your job classification and length of employment. * Life Insurance (Voluntary Life \& AD\&D for the employee and dependents)

**About The Role And Team**
 Engineering at Uber means building for real\-world impact under real\-world constraints. As a Software Engineer II, you will architect the foundational infrastructure that powers business decisions and core services for millions of users. Whether you are scaling distributed storage platforms or building high\-performance data pipelines, you will be solving complex challenges at the intersection of low latency, high correctness, and massive scale.
   

  

 The problems here are messy and the systems are global. You'll need to make smart decisions with imperfect information, own your work end\-to\-end, and stay calm when high\-load systems are on the line. We are looking for engineers who think in systems, pride themselves on robust monitoring, and believe that the best solutions are built through candid feedback and cross\-functional collaboration. If you're energized by challenges and motivated to move the real world \- this is where you'll grow.
   

  

 Rate of Pay: $171,000 to $209,000 per Year
   

  

 You will be eligible to participate in Uber's bonus program, and may be offered other types of comp. You will also be eligible for various benefits. More details can be found at the following link https://www.uber.com/careers/benefits.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Design and build backend systems that support message delivery optimization, frequency capping, and real\-time orchestration across channels.
* Work on critical infrastructure for timing models, pacing algorithms, and personalization engines that serve billions of messages monthly.
* Collaborate closely with Product, Applied Science, Data, and Marketing teams to ship features that have direct impact on user engagement and business growth.
* Write clean, maintainable code and participate in design reviews, code reviews, and incident response.
* May telecommute.


**Basic Qualifications**
* Employer will accept a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering (Any), Information Technology, Mathematics, Physics, or related field, and three years of experience in the job offered or in a related occupation.
* Position requires:
+ Backend language (Python, Java, Go, or TypeScript) and its standard libraries;
+ Design highly scalable components (not just functions); Microservices, API contract design (REST/gRPC), and caching strategies;
+ Data management using SQL/NoSQL, specifically database indexing, schema migrations, and query optimization;
+ CI/CD pipelines, Docker, and Kubernetes; Observability using tools such as Grafana or Datadog to debug production issues;
+ Computer science fundamentals (data structures, algorithms, and OOP);
+ Experience with distributed computing frameworks such as Apache Spark, Flink, or Hadoop for processing large\-scale datasets.

 As an engineer at Genesis, you will lead rapid iteration on our AI platform and infrastructure, unlocking the next level of performance, efficiency, and scale that was not previously possible. You will build massively distributed training and inference pipelines, core MLOps tools and frameworks, and optimize GPU operations to speed up ML models.
   

  

 Genesis is a highly\-collaborative and cross functional environment, and you will work in close partnership with our exceptional engineers, researchers, and scientists.
   

  

**You Will**
* Lead engineering efforts focused on continuous improvement of the AI platform, focused on rapid build out and iteration on scalable and robust distributed infrastructure for ML training, inference, and evaluation.
* Support model training and deployment across multiple clusters and multiple clouds, optimizing for throughput and cost.
* Optimizing efficiency of ML models and other workloads in terms of latency, throughput, memory consumption, etc. (e.g., via GPU performance engineering), pushing the limits of what’s possible with the current hardware.
* Contribute to the long\-term vision for Genesis’ infra platform.


**You are**
* Strong engineer who constantly strives for technical excellence. You can write clean code and have a deep understanding of the codebases you work in.
* Deeply experienced with distributed training and inference of large models on GPU clusters and some of the core libraries and frameworks we use: Pytorch, Pytorch Lightning, Pytorch Geometric, and Ray.
* Independent thinker with a strong sense of ownership and capability of engineering robust systems from first\-principles\-based conceptualization to state\-of\-the\-art realization.
* Curious, problem\-oriented thinker who is excited to dive deep into the emerging field at the intersection of AI, physics, chemistry, and biology and make foundational contributions and discoveries (no previous experience in anything but ML necessary).


**Nice to haves**
* Experienced with building, maintaining and debugging low\-level cluster infrastructure running on multiple clouds using Kubernetes and Terraform.
* Experienced GPU engineer who can quickly figure out performance bottlenecks and architect highly performant code for large scale ML workloads.
* Experience with XLA, Triton, CUDA, or similar accelerator programming languages and/or deep learning compiler stacks.
* Experience working with some of the following: molecular systems (protein sequences and 3D structures, small molecules, etc.), ML force fields or other physics\-informed models and methods, or point cloud data in other application domains, such as 3D graphics.


**Compensation, Benefits, And Perks**

* Comprehensive health benefits: Medical, Dental, and Vision (covered 100% for the employees).
* 401(k) plan.

**About Genesis Molecular AI**
 Genesis Molecular AI is pioneering foundation models for molecular AI to unlock a new era of drug design and development. Our generative and predictive AI platform, GEMS (Genesis Exploration of Molecular Space), integrates AI and physics into industry\-leading models to generate and optimize drug molecules, including the breakthrough generative diffusion model Pearl for structure prediction. Genesis is backed by premier AI and life science investors, including a16z, NVIDIA, Rock Springs Capital, Menlo Ventures, T. Rowe Price, Fidelity, and Radical Ventures. Genesis has also signed category\-leading AI\-pharma deals, the most recent of which was a significant expansion with Incyte (see coverage in Forbes and GEN) with a total potential deal value of several billion dollars.
   

  

 Genesis is headquartered in San Mateo, CA, with a fully integrated laboratory in San Diego. We are proud to be an inclusive workplace and an Equal Opportunity Employer.
